description: Verse digests a transcript or a PeerTube or Internet Archive video's open captions: the key points, answers to an optional question from the words themselves, and a short summary. One call, one digest. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/digest.

text.description: a transcript, at least a few sentences (or send url)

url.description: a PeerTube or Internet Archive video link

name: paid_digest
title: Digest a transcript or video (0.05 USDC, x402)
